keyVotes.head: Expand the child tax credit
keyVotes.official: Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act (H.R. 7024)
keyVotes.what: Expands the child tax credit for lower-income families and restores several business tax breaks.

keyVotes.head: End Social Security cuts for public-sector retirees
keyVotes.what: Ends two rules that cut Social Security benefits for many teachers, police officers and other public workers with pensions.

keyVotes.head: Require proof of citizenship to register to vote
keyVotes.what: Requires documents proving U.S. citizenship, such as a passport or birth certificate, to register to vote in federal elections.

keyVotes.head: Require hospitals and insurers to post prices
keyVotes.what: Requires hospitals, insurers and drug-benefit middlemen to publish prices, and changes some Medicare drug payments.

keyVotes.head: Cancel Biden's student loan forgiveness
keyVotes.what: Overturns President Biden's plan to forgive up to $20,000 in federal student loans per borrower.

keyVotes.head: Tighten asylum rules, restart the border wall
keyVotes.what: Restarts border wall construction, tightens asylum rules and requires employers to check workers' immigration status (E-Verify).

keyVotes.head: $61 billion in aid to Ukraine
keyVotes.law: April 24, 2024, in a combined foreign aid package
keyVotes.what: Provides about $61 billion in military and economic aid to Ukraine.

keyVotes.head: $26 billion in aid to Israel and for Gaza relief
keyVotes.law: April 24, 2024, in a combined foreign aid package
keyVotes.what: Provides about $26 billion for Israel's defense and for humanitarian aid, including in Gaza.

keyVotes.head: Expand oil, gas and mining, speed energy permits
keyVotes.what: Expands oil, gas and mining on federal land and water and speeds up permits for energy projects.

keyVotes.head: Require care for infants who survive an abortion
keyVotes.what: Requires doctors to give an infant born alive during an attempted abortion the same care as any newborn, with criminal penalties.

keyVotes.head: Overturn the ATF pistol-brace rule
keyVotes.what: Cancels a federal rule that treated pistols fitted with stabilizing braces like short-barreled rifles, which must be registered.

keyVotes.head: Raise the debt limit and cap spending
keyVotes.what: Suspends the debt limit until 2025 to avoid a default and caps federal spending for two years.

keyVotes.head: Extend tax cuts, cut Medicaid and food aid
keyVotes.what: Extends the 2017 tax cuts, adds tax breaks on tips, overtime and for seniors, cuts projected Medicaid and food-aid (SNAP) spending, adds money for border enforcement and defense, and raises the debt limit.

keyVotes.head: Require proof of citizenship to register to vote
keyVotes.what: Requires documents proving U.S. citizenship, such as a passport or birth certificate, to register to vote in federal elections.

keyVotes.topic: Two bills on stock trading by officials

bills.head: Ban new stock buys by Congress, add photo ID to vote
Ban stock trading by Congress, the President and Vice President
bills.by: Democratic bill; a petition to force a vote fell short

diffs: May keep; 7 days' public notice before selling
Covers the President and Vice President
Also requires photo ID to vote in person

bills.head: Expand small-business health plans, fund cost-sharing payments
bills.official: Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act (H.R. 6703)

bills.head: Extend ACA premium subsidies for 3 years
bills.by: Forced to a vote by a Democratic-led petition

diffs: Extends the larger ACA premium subsidies
Funds cost-sharing payments that lower some premiums
Expands small-business group plans and employer accounts for buying coverage

keyVotes.head: $70 billion more for ICE and Border Patrol
keyVotes.what: Adds about $70 billion for immigration enforcement and border security through 2029, passed by a simple majority under budget rules.

keyVotes.head: Loans for Ukraine's military, new Russia sanctions
keyVotes.what: Provides $8 billion in loans for Ukraine to buy weapons, extends U.S. military aid to Ukraine through 2027, and adds sanctions on Russia.

keyVotes.head: Permanently ban fentanyl look-alike drugs
keyVotes.what: Permanently lists fentanyl-related drugs with the most dangerous controlled substances, with mandatory minimum sentences for trafficking them.

keyVotes.head: Require care for infants who survive an abortion
keyVotes.what: Requires doctors to give an infant born alive during an attempted abortion the same care as any newborn, with criminal penalties.

keyVotes.head: Stop the VA flagging some veterans in gun checks
keyVotes.what: Stops the VA from reporting veterans who have someone managing their benefits to the gun background-check system unless a judge finds them dangerous.

keyVotes.head: Reopen the government after the 2025 shutdown
keyVotes.what: Ends the 43-day shutdown, funds the government through January 30, 2026, and passes full-year funding for food aid, veterans and military construction.
